author: Joey Carr
description:
There are plenty of memorable moments from the first few hours of the story in Grand Theft Auto 6. From rescuing a friend at a gang hideout to reliving Lucia's run-in with the law, the story certainly isn't dull at any point. However, perhaps the mission that players will remember the most from the opening hours of GTA 6 is "Pipework."

This mission requires you to collect rent money from some of Brian Heder's tenants in Key Lento. One of those tenants is a woman named Mandy, and it's crystal clear from the get-go that she's romantically interested in Jason. So, this begs the question: can you romance Mandy in GTA 6?

Is Mandy romanceable in GTA 6?

While all of the signs point to Mandy being a romance option for Jason in GTA 6, she is actually not able to be romanced whatsoever. This is despite Mandy's best eff
title: Can You Romance Mandy In GTA 6?

author: Phil Owen
description: I'm a male Millennial gamer pushing 40, so GTA is in my bones. But I currently like Fortnite more than I like any other game, and I figured I'd have a hard time pulling myself away even for an occasion as momentous as the arrival of Grand Theft Auto 6--especially after Epic announced the big One Piece-themed treasure hunt with oodles of free cosmetics at stake, including cars, Jam tracks, a token that lets you get the whole item shop free, and ultra-rare gold skins that you'll probably never be able to get any other way. That kind of stuff is catnip for a longtime Fortnite player like me, and it got me playing a lot more than
title: Fortnite’s Treasure Hunt Burned Me Out Just In Time For GTA 6

author: Tamoor Hussain
description:
One of the mainstay features in Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto series is radio stations that can be listened to while driving in cars or, as in GTA 6, on the go if you acquire headphones. As a music-discovery vehicle, GTA: Vice City introduced me to many '80s classics across a variety of genres. With GTA 6 taking players to Leonida, in which Vice City is located, it's apt that the game features music that many probably would never hear anywhere else.

One of the radio stations you'll find in the game is Kaleidoscope FM. It features covers of very-well-known songs that are performed by artists from around the world. It's a fantastic hook for a radio station and delivers some of the catchiest and most-unexpected covers from artists that have a pretty low profile outside of their home countries.

The first s
title: GTA 6’s Best Song Is A Nelly Furtado Cover From Azerbaijan

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
On the eve of GTA 6's official launch on November 19, Sony's PlayStation Network appears to be facing some issues, at least for some people, at some point, today.

Reports have emerged that the PSN is borked, and although the PlayStation Status website says everything is fine, that might not be true for everyone.

As with all outages, your mileage may vary. It was reported that the PSN had a temporary outage for launching games specifically, and this has
title: PSN Went Down Sorta On GTA 6 Eve

author: Mark Delaney
description:
GTA 6 Easter eggs are everywhere, it feels like. We've only just begun gathering them in this roundup, and it feels like there are so many more.

From books and store items to little nods in the dialogue or places of interest, Grand Theft Auto 6 is as much an amalgam of pop culture as it is a hyper-realized funhouse mirror of US culture.

We'll be regularly adding more GTA 6 Easter eggs to this article, so keep it bookmarked as you set off for your very long playthrough of GTA 6. 

In This Article
title: GTA 6 Easter Eggs Are Everywhere, But These Are The Best Ones

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
A lot of people are upset that they can't get GTA 6 on a physical disc, and KFC is now stepping up to do what Rockstar isn't.

KFC Spain has announced a "Replace the Disc" campaign where customers can get a free disc-shaped piece of fried chicken when they bring in their GTA 6 box. The promotion takes place December 19 and 20 from 4 to 8 PM at KFC locations in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, and others in the country.

GTA 6 is sold a
title: KFC Announces GTA 6 Promo Where You Get A Disc-Shaped Piece Of Chicken

author: Chris Pereira
description:
The hype around GTA 6 is enormous, but as we've been spotlighting, it's not the only new game worthy of your attention this month. Case in point: Australia Did It, which recently suffered a delay due to Steam's approval backlog and pushed its release even closer to GTA 6 than previously planned, is a delightful new tactics game that is now available and is worth carving out some time to play.

Australia Did It--which recently had its name changed to tack on the hilarious subtitle of End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business--is the new game from Aesthetican Labs and
title: The New Game That Will Be Pulling Me Away From GTA 6

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Microsoft and Take-Two recently announced a deal to allow people to stream Rockstar's GTA 6, and that significantly increases the game's addressable market on Xbox and means people can play the game for as little as $92.

This is according to a
title: How Xbox’s Streaming Deal For GTA 6 Could Expand Its Marketshare By 30%

author: Steve Watts
description:
The Game Awards nominees have been announced, officially starting the season of debate and discussion around the best games of the year. As always, this inspires some conversation around notable snubs, as nearly everyone has at least one personal fave that was overlooked for contention in the awards. I'm no exception, as two of my favorite games of the year are nearly completely absent from The Game Awards consideration. But it's the similarity between the two omissions that strikes me: They are both retro-style 2D games passed over in favor of slates of 3D games.

Specifically, I'm referring to Mina the Hollower and Castlevania: Belmont's Curse. The former is Yacht Club's masterpiece: a game that seamlessly blends classic Game Boy-era Zelda sensibilities with the scope and density of an Elder Scrolls. The latter
title: The Game Awards Snubbed 2D Games, And I Took That Personally

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Now that Rockstar's GTA 6 is available, people are discovering all manner of things in the game's gigantic open world. One such finding is that GTA 6 has its own take on Easter eggs, and Rockstar was quite literal.

Twitter user xGarbett posted a video of Jason climbing to the top of a
title: GTA 6 Has A Hilarious Riff On Easter Eggs

author: Joey Carr
description:
From the very first mission in Grand Theft Auto 6 until the credits roll, money is the core focus throughout the story. It's the constant motivation for both Jason and Lucia, as well as all of their associates during the game. There are even sections of the main story where you can't progress until you've made a certain amount of money, so you'll have to know the best ways to make money one way or another.

Once you become a pro at bringing in cash, though, you might have some questions about what to do with all of the money in your BuckMe account. You can blow through money extremely quickly in GTA 6, but there are some wiser investments you can make that pay off more in the long run. Below, we'll run through a few of the best ways to spend money in GTA 6, as well as s
title: Best Ways To Spend Your Money In GTA 6

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Grand Theft Auto games have been home to some weird phenomena over the years, and in GTA 6, it looks like Bigfoot is back and stinkier than ever. As the game steadily rolls out worldwide--or as people digitally immigrate to New Zealand for early access--streamers have been posting clips online of their encounters with the cryptid, and this time, it doesn't look like a man in a suit.

It looks like the Bigfoot sighting is tied to a mission in GTA 6, as the mysterious creature is wandering the woods of Leonida and it takes off in a panic when you encounter it.
title: Bigfoot Is Back In GTA 6, And Apparently He Smells Revolting

author: Chris Pereira
description:
For those still waiting for GTA 6 to unlock, it's possible you have something of a mistaken impression of what the early hours will look like. Despite partially sharing a setting with GTA Vice City, you should not expect to be walking up the game's equivalent of Ocean Drive and Miami Beach in the opening minutes, as in the 2002 game. Far from it.

As we noted in our video discussion on why we gave GTA 6 a 10/10 in our review, Tamoor and Jake did some expectation-setting. Rather than starting the game in Vice City, you'll instead spend the opening hours in a smaller corner of the state of Leonida, Key Lento. Vice City is undoubtedly the crown jewel of the game's world, but it could be as much as 20 hours before you reach it, depending on how you play.

Thi
title: Don’t Expect To See Vice City For A Long Time In GTA 6

author: Joey Carr
description:
The early part of Grand Theft Auto 6 basically gives you the chance to own a single vehicle, or two if you purchased the Ultimate Edition to get Jason's motorcycle. Aside from Jason's Granada and motorcycle, though, you can't own any additional personal vehicles until much later in the game. However, even then, you're limited to just a few owned vehicle slots in GTA 6.

While this does limit you early on, there are ways to own more vehicles by adding to the number of slots you have. This allows you to register more and more vehicles in GTA 6, giving you an expanded list of cars, motorcycles, and bikes that you can store or call to your character at a moment's notice. Owning more vehicles doesn't just magically happen in GTA 6, though, so here are all of the ways you can increase your owned vehicle slots.

As a
title: How To Own More Cars And Other Vehicles In GTA 6

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 co-protagonist Jason is, like many Americans, a fan of cats. Naturally, being an open-world game with seemingly endless possibilities, GTA 6 does indeed let Jason express that love by petting cats he sees. However, not every cat is down to be pals with Jason.

As shared on social media, if you're walking around Leonida and spot a friendly-looking cat, you can go give it a pet. Jason even talks to the cat, because you'd have to be a monster not to, and the action even gives him a little focus boost.

But not all cats are the same. Another clip shared online shows Jason carjacking someone, as one does in GTA. After driving away, loud meowing can be heard, and the camera cuts to
title: Jason Loves Cats In GTA 6, But Not All Of Them

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
While the official GTA 6 soundtrack is a behemoth of its own, featuring over 30 tracks of fantastic music, the radio stations you'll tune into while you're cruising around Leonida--or listening in on your phone--are something else entirely. There's a massive list of songs that you can stumble upon, and we've tried to list them all here for you.

As is the case with most of our GTA 6 guides, we'll continue to update this as and when we discover something new. If you've heard something that we haven't included, feel free to let us know.
title: All GTA 6 Radio Stations And Songs

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The Grand Theft Auto 6 map is absolutely massive, gigantic, and at least one more synonym to encapsulate its size accurately. Whether it's land, sea, or air, covering it is going to take a lot of time, but just how many hours should you set aside for a flight across Leonida?

We found out for ourselves by piloting a single-propeller plane across the map, which took us an entire four minutes and 10 seconds between the two points on the map. That's pretty big!

We've known for a while that the GTA 6 map was going to be big--with roughly more pla
title: How Long Does It Take To Fly Across The Entire GTA 6 Map?

author: Joey Carr
description:
When you choose to add items to your character's loadout in Grand Theft Auto 6, you likely prioritize weapons and body armor over anything else. After all, these are what protect you from enemies and can make the difference between living and dying during a firefight. While you certainly want to make sure you always have weapons and armor in GTA 6, you'll also want to make sure you have a parachute equipped.

A parachute is a highly underrated item to have in your loadout, as it comes in handy if you steal a plane or another aircraft and need to bail. The parachute is also extremely fun to use, especially if you're trying to complete Base Jump challenges. Below, we'll go over where you can find a parachute, as well as some of the best locations to make use of it in GTA 6.
title: How To Get A Parachute In GTA 6 (And Best Places To Use It)

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
We might not hear from him much, but Rockstar co-founder Sam Houser remains highly involved with the studio and its games, and that includes GTA 6, which is available now in New Zealand and everywhere else on November 19.

To mark the game's launch, Houser released a statement in which he said Rockstar has once again tried to create a game in GTA 6 that "exceeds your expectations" and shows "what this medium is capable of, and why we believe games are so special."
title: Rockstar Founder Issues Rare Statement As GTA 6 Launches To Superb Reviews And Huge Sales

author: Callum Self
description:
Despite owning a pretty decent gaming PC, a PlayStation Portal with my PS5, and a Nintendo Switch 2, my most-used device is still a Steam Deck. Playing on a handheld PC is no joke—I can keep playing my library of over 700 games (well, so long as they’re playable) without leaving the comfort of my bed. The OLED model, in particular, offers a sharp, vibrant picture that beats out my aging 1440p LED monitor, to the point where that 32-inch display is outdone by the Steam Deck’s much smaller design. If I had gotten it for $1 / £1, I’d be the happiest player in the world, and for someone, that dream will come true.

As a PC player, I know what it’s like to have a massive backlog. You see games on sale, you add them, and you promise you’ll eventually get to them. The Steam Deck has truly helped me get through games I haven’t managed to play before, like finally beating Gotham Knights… again. It’s the second time, okay? Steam
title: You Could Grab A Steam Deck OLED For As Low As $1

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The nominees for 2026's The Game Awards have been announced, but which games and publishers scored the most total nominations?

The most-nominated game this year Grand Theft Auto 6, which picked up eight total nominations, including a nod for Game of the Year. The game being nominated at all surprised some people considering that it's not even out yet, but members of the voting jury had played it already.

In terms of the most-nom
title: Here Are The Most Nominated Games And Publishers At The Game Awards This Year

author: Steve Watts
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is absolutely massive in scope, with a dense and sprawling Vice City and a diverse surrounding area of swamps and dusty little towns. The simulation of Florida, called Leonida in the GTA universe, is so massive that there's no reason you really need to leave. But just in case you attempt to escape, Rockstar has ways of making you stay.

If you leave by air, the solution is simple. Hitting the invisible boundary of the outer reaches in Leonida's map, you'll immediately run out of gas and crash. You should've thought of that before you tried to fly to fake-Georgia. Similarly, if you try to escape by jet ski you run out of gas, but instead of crashing you're just stranded in the middle of the ocean.

There may be other elements at play as well. One streamer,
title: GTA 6: Here’s What Happens If You Try To Leave Leonida Entirely

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
As with all Grand Theft Auto games, in GTA 6, the police will come after you if you commit a crime with witnesses. However, their response time will not always be the same, and you may be able to use this to your advantage, depending on the situation.

As we learned during our time with Grand Theft Auto 6 so far, the police will respond more slowly if you are assaulting a gang hideout. Presumably, this is because the police force believes you're doing them a favor, but regardless, they will still show up if you get into an all-out firefight and make a bunch of noise.
title: The GTA 6 Police Don’t Have Equal Response Times For All Crimes

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie includes a lot of swearing, with main character Bryan (Austin Abrams) saying the words "f**k" and "shit" over and over again as he faces a nightmare in Raccoon City. But the film could have had a lot more swearing.

Cregger said in a new interview with Sony for the movie's home release, that, "The whole thing was carpeted with f**ks. You think there's a lot of f**ks in there now? You should have heard the rough cut. It was insane."

Abrams said he isn't sure how many of the swear words were written into the script, saying there was "definitely a lot improvised."

Cregger, who co-wrote the script with Shay Hatten, said the original script indeed had a lot more f**ks in it. "We tried to go in and take as many as we possibly could out of the movie. I think we probably pulled 70%," he said.
title: “The “F**k Cut”– Resident Evil Movie Has A Version With A Lot More Swearing

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Contrary to popular belief, you'll need some nutrients to sustain your Grand Theft Auto 6 sessions this week. That means losing valuable time whipping up a meal or driving to your nearest Cluckin' Bell, but McDonald's in the US is aiming to make refueling easier by teaming up with the instant messaging app Discord.

While the fast-food chain already offers a delivery service via its McDelivery app, you won't need to reach for your smartphone to access it. Instead, you can open the McDonald's activity in Discord--which is available on console--place a McDelivery order on Uber Eats, and go back to GTA 6 while you wait for your order to arrive. Alternatively, you can also play Fast Lane Feast, a Discord-exclusive minigame where you collect burgers and chips while racing for a spot on the leaderboards.
title: McDonald’s Knows You Won’t Want To Pause GTA 6 To Make Dinner

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
If you've played Rockstar series like Grand Theft Auto or Read Dead Redemption over the past few decades, then you're familiar with their default control scheme, which maps sprinting to a face button instead of the left analog stick. But Grand Theft Auto VI isn't being hailed as a revolutionary game for nothing--at long last, the default scheme has changed.

As we learned while playing Grand Theft Auto VI, instead of the default setup mapping sprint to a button (A on Xbox and X on PS5), the game maps it to the left analog stick. However, you're free to switch it back to the style used in games like Red Dead Redemption 2, if you prefer.

This is a very hand
title: GTA 6 Finally Changed The Default Rockstar-Game Controls

author: Chris Pereira
description:
In all the excitement surrounding Grand Theft Auto VI (check out our 10/10 review), it might be tempting to upgrade your setup. For a game 13 years in the making, is now the time to upgrade my TV? Maybe a PS5 Pro is in order? It's a coincidence I finally upgraded my speaker system after 18 years, I swear.

One cheaper upgrade than those above you might be considering is a better controller, like a DualSense Edge or Xbox Elite controller. For all of their myriad upgrades, the most essential reason to ever buy one of these, in my opinion, is for the back paddles. Although they are not technically extra buttons, the ability to map an inconveniently placed button to one of them can make an experience far smoother. 

Some games make an exceptionally strong case for only playing with paddles. You do a lot of spri
title: GTA 6 Isn’t Worth Buying A Fancy Controller For

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
There are many questions swirling around the internet right now, as the global launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 begins to roll out. Who are the voice actors? How long does it take to beat GTA 6? But, perhaps most importantly, how financially screwed are you if you want to drive across Leonida rather than taking advantage of the extensive public transport network?

Well, thanks to streamer AaronGameDeveloperAU, we know the answer now. Via the clip below, at least in the Key Lento area--which is the starting area of the game--it'll set you back
title: How Much Does Gas Cost In GTA 6 Vs. Real Life?

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
At long last, Grand Theft Auto 6 launch day has come. With Rockstar's latest project steadily unlocking as the clock strikes midnight worldwide, GTA 6 reviews have gone live, and the praise has been overwhelmingly positive so far. In fact, GTA 6 is reviewing so well that it's currently tied with the 1998 The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as the highest-rated game of all time on GameSpot's sister site Metacritic, a feat that has taken 28 years to equal.

So what are the reviewers saying? Amongst the flurry of perfect scores, a lot of the consensus is geared toward the world that Rockstar Games has created for its co-protagonists to inhabit, a sandbox that reacts to you in a variety of unique and interesting ways. It's a genre-defining experience for ope
title: GTA 6 Is Apparently Everything Rockstar Promised And Then Some

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally arrived--at least in New Zealand and Australia. Lots of people are playing the game already and have made a number of discoveries, including just how massive the map is.

Even though we knew the GTA 6 map would be big--it has
title: The GTA 6 Map Is Truly, Truly Massive (Of Course)

author: Jade King
description:
The Nintendo GameCube is celebrating its 25-year anniversary on November 18, 2026. Below, we look back at its controller and why it's still considered an all-time great.

There are myriad video game controllers we’ve come to hold dear over the years. Whether it be the reliable yet simplistic Xbox 360 pad, the charmingly petite DualShock 3, or the unique form factor offered by the Switch Joy-Con. Every single peripheral has its own distinct history, as they work hand in hand with the games we play and fall in love with. But I struggle to think of one with more of a legacy than the
title: The Nintendo GameCube Controller Was So Good That It Refuses To Die

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
PS5 Pro consoles have been hard to find lately, but there is a trick to getting one: All you need is superb basketball skills and membership on an NBA team based in the state that inspired Grand Theft Auto 6's location. Easy! While it's a little too late to take advantage of this life hack now, things have worked out for the Miami Heat, as they were gifted a unique set of PS5 Pro consoles this week.

Miami Heat player Myron Gardner posted a photo of the care package that arrived for him, which includes the aforementioned PS5 Pro console, two officially licensed GTA 6 DualSense contro
title: Want A Custom GTA 6 PS5 Pro? Just Play In The NBA

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
After more than 10 years of waiting, Rockstar's GTA 6 is finally available now (at least in New Zealand and Australia). The anticipation has been sky-high for both consumers and investors alike, and Rockstar's owner, Take-Two, is seeing a huge uplift in its share price today after the game's overwhelmingly positive reviews landed.

The US stock market doesn't officially open until 9:30 AM ET, but ahead of that, Take-Two shares are up close to 7% in pre-market trading. If this holds, it wo
title: GTA 6 Owner Take-Two’s Stock Explodes After High Review Scores, But It’s Still Down Massively This Year

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is rolling out worldwide, and if you have a GTA+ subscription, you can pick up extra goodies for your trip to Vice City. Developer Rockstar Games has revealed that it'll be evolving its subscription service to cover both GTA Online and GTA 6, and for $8 a month, players can unlock several in-game benefits, including store discounts, more public transit options, and better haggling power.

If you've preordered GTA 6, you'll automatically get a month of GTA+ for free. One thing to note: the services below are only available while you're subscribed, so if your membership expires or you cancel, those perks will no longer be available. Here's a breakdown of what you'll get if you stay subscribed.

Venturas Blvd Elegy supercar
title: GTA 6’s GTA+ Subscription Includes A Free Supercar, Discounts, And More

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
At first glance, it might seem like Grand Theft Auto 6 has no cheats system. However, it's a GTA game, so it does exist in there somewhere--there are just a few prerequisites you need to complete before you can use it. In fact, if you try to use any of these GTA 6 cheat codes before you've completed the below steps, you'll be unsuccessful. We loaded a fresh save to test that, so you don't have to. There are also challenges tied to each of the cheat codes, so it could be quite some time before you unlock them all. Having said that, the game does take into account the challenges you've already completed before unlocking cheats.

In This Article
title: All GTA 6 Cheats And How To Unlock Them

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 has officially launched, and unsurprisingly, it's earning rave reviews. It's arriving hot on the heels of several critically acclaimed games this year, but does it have enough momentum to knock the current best-reviewed game of the year, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, off its throne? The answer is a resounding yes: not only is GTA 6 being reviewed higher than Nintendo's little hero in green, but it's also emerging as one of the highest-rated games of all time.

When Ocarina of Time launched in early November, it quickly shot to the top of the Metacritic charts,
title: GTA 6 Has A Metacritic Score So High It’s Only Happened Once Before

author: Jake Dekker
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here. After 13 years, Rockstar's follow-up might even be bigger and deeper than you expected. With so much to do and see, we've rounded up 13 tips to help you stay healthy, wealthy, and well-armed in Vice City. Here are 13 things we wish we knew before we started playing GTA 6.

Create healthy habits

More than any other GTA game before it, Grand Theft Auto 6 leans into its simulation. This means you should eat, sleep, shower, and work out on a regular basis in order to maximize Jason and Lucia’s capabilities. While neglecting these activities won’t ruin the game, it will certainly put you at a disadvantage. 

Jason and Lucia’s capabilities are split into three core stats: Health, Stamin
title: GTA 6 Tips: Everything I Wish I Knew Before I Started Playing

author: Jake Dekker
description:
Robberies are the lifeblood of Grand Theft Auto 6, and there’s an art to doing them effectively. In this guide, we'll teach you how to rob everything from tiny convenience stores to high-security vaults. If you've started playing it for yourself, you've maybe already seen that safes require safe codes to open them quietly. We'll go over how those work, too, and explain why you can't actually rely on a GTA 6 safe codes list.

How to do robberies in GTA 6

Let’s start with the basics. Before hitting a place of business, check the map to see its security level. Each store falls into one of three classifications: Low, Medium, and High. Many factors contribute to an establishment's security level, but nearly every spot has at least three
title: GTA 6 Safe Codes And Robberies Guide

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is massive. It's inundated with seemingly endless side missions, activities, and other things to get lost in while you're roaming around the sprawling world of Leonida. With the campaign taking in excess of 65 hours to complete, you might be wondering if it's possible to continue playing once you're finished with the main missions, or if there's no turning back once you complete Jason and Lucia's storyline.

The good news is that yes, you can continue playing GTA 6 after finishing the main campaign. That means there's plenty of time to get into the depths of Leonida if you're the type of player who just wants to steamroll through the main campaign on your first playthrough. It also means you won't need to rely on your GTA 6
title: Can You Keep Playing After Finishing GTA 6’s Story?

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Now that GTA 6 is finally here, you might be wondering how to save your game. With so many options, side missions, and choices that impact the outcome of the story, it's tempting to reload a previous save to get the most out of your GTA 6 experience. While you can save your game, there are a couple of important caveats you should be aware of.

Firstly, there are only 15 save slots available in GTA 6. This means you should pick your save points pretty carefully, as in an 80-hour game, there'll be many points where you might want to play conservatively. Right near the beginning of the game, for example, if Jason doesn't complete all of the tasks to renovate the house before picking up Lucia, he won't get a chance to do them again when she's home. That could be
title: How Do You Save Your Game In GTA 6?

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
If you've just jumped into Rockstar's mammoth game, you might be wondering how to freely switch between Jason and Lucia--the game's two protagonists. While we start Grand Theft Auto 6 in Jason's shoes, there's a good chunk of the narrative that plays out with you seemingly unable to manually swap between controlling him or Lucia. The good news is that it doesn't remain that way for the entire game.

Once you've completed around 30% of the main story, you'll gain the ability to switch between Jason and Lucia. To do so, just press L1/LB at any time. Depending on the amount of side missions you've done, your completed percentage might show as higher or lower than 30%, so that's just a rough guide.

After that point, there are both missions where you need to play as one ch
title: How To Switch Between Jason And Lucia In GTA 6

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
With GTA 6 finally in our hands, and after the biggest ever launch for a game, millions of people are now playing through Jason and Lucia's adventures. The main campaign follows the duo as they take on a series of missions, with their story unfolding more with each one. However, there are some missions where you might not be completely satisfied with the outcome, or perhaps you just want to relive some of your favorite ones. There are a few different options if you're feeling like this.

First of all, you can't technically replay an old mission from the GTA 6 menu after it's been completed. To do that, you'd need to reload an earlier GTA 6 save from your manual collection, since the autosave feature automatically overwrites older saves. You also cannot launch old missions after completing the campaign, so if you really want to replay one
title: Can You Replay Missions In GTA 6?

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
While the urge to be an absolute menace in Grand Theft Auto 6 is strong, nothing stops you from playing as a law-abiding citizen who sticks to the speed limit between missions. This option to avoid attracting local law enforcement's attention will probably be best experienced on PS5, thanks to one key advantage: the DualSense controller and its adaptive triggers.

On PS5, GTA 6 players can keep their vehicle from going over the speed limit, as the adaptive triggers provide resistance when you get close to the legal limit. That doesn't mean that you can't break past that barrier, but the adaptive triggers will help you match traffic speed most of the time and stick to legal restrictions. That essentially makes it easier to control your vehicle and gives your index fingers a sense of how hard to press the triggers--useful when you're trying to avoid dinging
title: GTA 6 Has A Clever PS5 DualSense Trick For Keeping You Under The Speed Limit

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Jason and Lucia might be Grand Theft Auto 6's criminal power couple (if you want them to be), but can you actually take the two protagonists on dates? Well, sort of.

GTA 6 features a relationship system that allows the two to spend time together, strengthen their bond, and enjoy activities together across Leonida. However, there's no dedicated dating menu or a traditional romance system with a list of date locations to choose from. Instead, Rockstar has taken a more organic approach to Jason and Lucia's relationship, allowing you to bring them together through normal activities. 

You can invite Jason or Lucia to spend time together by asking the other character to head out into the world or join them for specific activities available on the map. There's a useful heart icon that illustrates which activities and in
title: Can Jason And Lucia Go On Dates In GTA 6?

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally in our hands, but you might still be keen to know whether you'll need a constant internet connection to explore Vice City and the wider state of Leonida. The good news is that there are some situations where you can play GTA 6 offline. However, don't expect to be able to spend an entire afternoon exploring without going back online.

During the review period of GTA 6, we tested the digital PS5 version of the game without an internet connection. The game does allow you to jump into its single-player experience, but there's a pretty frustrating catch: after approximately an hour, the game asks you to confirm your license again. If you don't, it'll kick you out.

That means that GTA 6 isn't technically an always-online game, but playing without a connection indefinitely
title: Can You Play GTA 6 Offline?

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is here, and it's an absolute spectacle. With potentially the hugest budget ever used for a video game, followed by a seriously monumental marketing campaign, the game has a spectacular level of detail, right down to the cutscenes. 

However, the cinematics aren't for everyone. If you just don't care about Jason and Lucia, maybe you're reloading an old save, or you're gearing up to get the world's first speedrun record for the game, there are a small handful of reasons why you might want to skip GTA 6 cutscenes.

Thankfully, Rockstar doesn't judge, and there is a way to skip cutscenes. When one is playing GTA 6, you can simply hold X/A depending on your console, and the cutscene will be skipped.

title: Can You Skip Cutscenes In GTA 6?

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally in our grubby little hands, and after years (and years) of waiting, we've finished it. If you're just about to get into the game, you might be wondering just how much of a time sink it's going to be. While we recommend taking your time and exploring all of Leonida at your own pace, as games media we didn't quite have that luxury. The benefit for you is that we can give you a pretty good recommendation of how many hours you can expect it to take to complete GTA 6's main story.

To finish GTA 6, you can expect to spend anywhere upwards of 65 hours on the main campaign. Some of our staff spent more time exploring the side missions and other activities, clocking in at 90-100 hours. However, so far no-one on the GameSpot team has completed 100% of the game--we're
title: How Long To Beat GTA 6

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Look, it happens. You're getting deep into the storyline of Grand Theft Auto 6 and you've found yourself in a spot of trouble. Maybe you were too laser-focused on completing a heist, went a bit too heavy-handed, and some ticked off police officers managed to injure you while you were getting away. Maybe you ran into an alligator who was having a bad day. Whatever the reason, you might find yourself injured in GTA 6 and wondering how to get yourself patched up so you can carry on.

In GTA 6, you'll mainly heal using Zombix or Adrenaline products. However, there are certain food and drink items you can use, much like GTA Online's snacks, to help you heal, too. Items with a pink heart will restore your health up to the maximum, while items with an orange heart will temporarily boost your health beyond the normal maximum.
title: How To Heal In GTA 6

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Running out of space for weapons and equipment in GTA 6? Unlike some other open-world games, GTA 6 doesn't offer a traditional inventory upgrade system. However, there's another way to carry more equipment without having to be super selective about your loadout.

Rather than increasing the amount of gear Jason and Lucia can carry on their person, GTA 6 makes use of the vehicle trunk system, allowing you to store additional items in your cars. 

There's no way to directly increase your character's inventory capacity in GTA 6, so you can't buy a larger backpack, upgrade your carrying capacity, or unlock additional slots via progression.
